issues: Image paths in `initDOM` and `renderBuildGrid` use `public/assets/...` which will throw 404 errors if served from a root or bundler base where `public/` isn't mirrored at runtime. Ensure asset paths match the project's relative asset loader config.

The placement reason tooltip updates position on `handleHover` using `renderer.tileToScreen(tx, ty)`, but if `renderer` lacks this method or returns undefined coordinates, it will throw an unhandled TypeError.
Event listener cleanup (`removeEventListener`) is absent; if `UI` instances are torn down or re-initialized on new games, window keydown listeners will accumulate and duplicate callbacks.
